description: Writes a tamper-evident, structured audit event to the client's audit.log file after every pipeline action. Computes a SHA256 hash of the input and output payloads to ensure audit integrity. Non-blocking — runs asynchronously so it does not delay pipeline execution. Required by RBI's IS Audit framework, SEBI LODR, and internal compliance teams for full traceability of every adapter call, credential resolution, and decision point in the integration pipeline. Also functions as the regulatory evidence trail for KYC and credit bureau pulls.
use_cases: Writing regulatory audit trail for every API call (KYC, bureau, payments)
Providing tamper-evident log of consent and credential access
Meeting RBI IS audit and internal compliance requirements
Creating forensic evidence for any disputed integration decision
Tracking which stage and agent triggered each pipeline action
when_to_use: Attach to every adapter in all integrations. Mandatory for KYC, bureau, payment, and health record adapters for regulatory compliance.
trigger_condition: After every pipeline action (adapter call, credential resolve, validation)

input_parameters.description: Client workspace identifier for log routing
Pipeline stage that triggered the audit event
Name of the executed pipeline action
Name of the executing agent or system component
Input data dictionary (sanitized — no raw credentials)
Output data dictionary from the action

output.on_success: Audit entry written with SHA256 hash; entry_id returned
output.on_failure: Falls back to system_audit.log at root level; never silently discards audit events

error_codes.HOOK_002: IO error writing to client audit log.
error_codes.HOOK_003: Attempted to log unresolved credential value.
